args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions after deploying v2.3.1 (error rate 0.18, unhealthy). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older).

2. **Rolled back**: checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions. Rollout completed successfully.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback; on-call has been paged.

4. **Verified**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate back down to 0.002.
